Every surface reads this file through scripts/lib/porch_packages.js: the FAQ Price my porch calculator, the full grid + Offer schema on the porch service pages, /pricing and the porch articles (scripts/install_porch_packages.js), the /request porch question (no tier prices there, only the from-price and range lines), the admin card line, the invoice prefill and the admin Porch packages reference grid. seasons.name: Fall / Halloween

classic.includes: A fuller porch display: more pumpkins and gourds in mixed sizes, door accent, layered height.

grand.includes: A large display across the porch and steps with a statement piece.

showstopper.includes: Porch, steps and walkway, fully layered, our most dramatic look.

seasons.customLine: Every porch is a custom design. We add accents like mums, hay, cornstalks, lanterns, wreaths and lighting to fit your porch and your style.
seasons.imageAlt: A Memphis-area front porch decorated for fall with pumpkins and layered seasonal styling

seasons.name: Winter / Christmas

classic.includes: Wreath, door garland and a pair of porch accents.

grand.includes: Garland across the door and railings, wreaths, lit accents, steps styled.

showstopper.includes: The full porch: lit garland everywhere, windows, statement pieces.

seasons.customLine: Every porch is a custom design. We add accents like garland, wreaths, lit trees, lanterns, ribbon and poinsettias to fit your porch and your style.
seasons.imageAlt: A Collierville front door decorated for Christmas with a wreath and garland

addOns.line: Want more? Ask about add-ons: takedown, extra pumpkins or accents, a Thanksgiving refresh, lighting, matching windows or a lamp post.

bundle.line: Book fall and Christmas together and save 10% on your Christmas package.

estimateLine: Rough estimate; final price after a quick look at your porch.
finalQuoteLine: Your final quote depends on the design you want, your porch size and how much decor. We'll confirm it after a quick look.

form.question: How much decor are you picturing?
form.notSure: Not sure yet, help me decide
form.bothSeasonsHelp: Book fall and Christmas together and save 10% on your Christmas package.

sizeHint: Not sure which one? A small stoop is usually our Stoop package, a standard porch our Classic, and a large porch or one with steps our Grand.
